subject: general
question:
**Select the correct option for the Direct Speech conversion of the sentence below.**

The physicist remarked that time-reversal invariance could be violated under non-unitary evolution.

options.text: The physicist said, "Time-reversal invariance can be violated under non-unitary evolution."
He remarked, "If evolution is non-unitary, time-reversal invariance will be violated."
The physicist said, "Time-reversal invariance could be violated under non-unitary evolution."
He said, "Time reversal violates when evolution non-unitary."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The physicist remarked that time-reversal invariance could be violated under non-unitary evolution.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"could be violated" becomes "can be violated"**
 
 
• When the reporting verb is in the past tense (remarked), the modal "can" in direct speech back-shifts to "could" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **"under non-unitary evolution" remains "under non-unitary evolution"**
 
 
• No structural or pronoun change is needed as the phrase is consistent in both direct and indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "remarked"
 
• Converted to: "said" for direct speech.
 
• In direct speech, the comma separates the reporting verb from the quoted text.
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• The first word inside the quotes "Time-reversal" starts with a capital letter.
 
 
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *The physicist said, "Time-reversal invariance can be violated under non-unitary evolution."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 3:** The physicist said, "Time-reversal invariance could be violated under non-unitary evolution." 
 
 
• Incorrect: This option fails to reverse the back-shift of the modal verb; 'could' in indirect speech should revert to 'can' in direct speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** He remarked, "If evolution is non-unitary, time-reversal invariance will be violated." 
 
 
• Incorrect: Adding a conditional "if" and changing the modal to "will" alters the original sentence structure and meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** He said, "Time reversal violates when evolution non-unitary." 
 
 
• Incorrect: The sentence structure and grammar are incorrect and do not match the original statement.
